title: Examen final de A1
intro: 30 preguntas de las Unidades 1 a 8: vocabulario, gramática, escucha y lectura. Con 70% o más apruebas A1 y pasas a A2.

routine.title: La rutina de Ana
routine.text: My name is Ana. I have a simple routine. I wake up at 6:30 every day. I get up and I have breakfast at 7. I go to work at 8. I work in the morning and in the afternoon. I have lunch at 1. In the evening I go home. I have dinner at 7:30. Then I watch TV. I usually go to bed at 11. On Sunday I don’t work. I get up late and I sometimes study. My brother has a different routine. He goes to school at 7:30. He doesn’t work. He is a student.

home.title: El apartamento de Leo
home.text: My name is Leo. I live in a small apartment. There is a living room and a kitchen. There are two bedrooms and one bathroom. My apartment is near the park. There is a supermarket next to my building. The bank is on the same street. To go to the hospital, go straight and turn left. It is near the school. I like my apartment. It is small but it is nice.

questions.question: Son las 9 de la noche y te despides para ir a dormir. ¿Qué dices?
questions.why: Good night se usa para despedirte por la noche.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se dice «hermana» en inglés?
questions.why: Sister = hermana; brother = hermano.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se dice «desayunar»?
questions.why: Breakfast es el desayuno; lunch, el almuerzo; dinner, la cena.

questions.question: ¿En qué parte de la casa cocinas?
questions.why: Kitchen = cocina.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se dice «al lado de»?
questions.why: Next to = al lado de; under = debajo de.

questions.question: Quieres saber el precio de algo. ¿Qué preguntas?
questions.why: How much is it? pregunta cuánto cuesta.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se dice «tiempo libre»?
questions.why: Free time = tiempo libre; weekend = fin de semana.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se dice «todo derecho»?
questions.why: Straight ahead = todo derecho; turn left = gira a la izquierda.

questions.question: Vas al trabajo en bus todos los días. ¿Qué dices?
options: I walk the bus to work.
I go the bus to work.
I drive the bus to work.
I take the bus to work.
questions.why: Con medios de transporte se usa take: take the bus.

questions.question: They ___ from Brazil.
questions.why: Con we, you y they se usa are.

questions.question: This is my brother. ___ name is Carlos.
questions.why: Para un hombre se usa his; para una mujer, her.

questions.question: She ___ two children.
questions.why: Con he, she e it, have cambia a has.

questions.question: He ___ to school at 7:30.
questions.why: En presente simple, con he, she e it el verbo lleva -s o -es: goes.

questions.question: I ___ work on Sunday.
questions.why: La negación con I, you, we y they es don’t + verbo.

questions.question: ___ she work in the morning?
questions.why: La pregunta con he, she e it empieza con Does.

questions.question: ___ two bedrooms in my apartment.
questions.why: Con plural se usa there are; con singular, there is.

questions.question: I’d like ___ apple, please.
questions.why: Antes de un sonido vocal se usa an: an apple.

questions.question: I like ___ books in my free time.
questions.why: Después de like se usa el verbo con -ing: I like reading.

questions.question: Escucha. ¿Qué te preguntan?
questions.why: How old are you? pregunta la edad.

questions.question: Escucha. ¿Sobre qué preguntan?
questions.why: What time do you have lunch? pregunta a qué hora almuerzas.
questions.audio: What time do you have lunch?

questions.question: Escucha. ¿Qué busca la persona?
questions.why: Is there a supermarket near here? busca un supermercado cerca.
questions.audio: Is there a supermarket near here?

questions.question: Escucha. ¿Qué pide la persona?
questions.why: I’d like a coffee and some bread = quiero un café y pan.
questions.audio: I'd like a coffee and some bread, please.

questions.question: Escucha. ¿Qué hace ella todos los días?
questions.why: She listens to music every day = escucha música todos los días.
questions.audio: She listens to music every day.

questions.question: Escucha. ¿Qué lugar busca la persona?
questions.why: Where is the bank? busca el banco.
questions.audio: Excuse me, where is the bank?

questions.question: ¿A qué hora desayuna Ana?
questions.why: El texto dice: I have breakfast at 7.

questions.question: ¿Qué hace Ana el domingo?
options: No trabaja y se levanta tarde.
questions.why: On Sunday I don’t work. I get up late.

questions.question: ¿Por qué el hermano de Ana no trabaja?
questions.why: He doesn’t work. He is a student.

questions.question: ¿Cuántos dormitorios tiene el apartamento de Leo?
questions.why: There are two bedrooms.

questions.question: ¿Qué hay al lado del edificio de Leo?
questions.why: There is a supermarket next to my building.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se llega al hospital?
options: Todo derecho y luego a la izquierda.
Todo derecho y luego a la derecha.
questions.why: Go straight and turn left.
